name: svg-draw
title: SVG Draw
description: Wrap any inline SVG and it draws itself in: every path, line, circle, rect and polygon traces its outline, one after another, then its fill fades in. Outline icons draw in their own stroke, filled logos are traced in a thin line that fades as they fill. Plays when it scrolls into view or on mount. GSAP DrawSVG and ScrollTrigger.
docs: Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/component/svg-draw GSAP plugins (DrawSVGPlugin, ScrollTrigger) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up. Wrap inline SVG markup, not an : only shapes in the page DOM can be traced. Give it a new key to play it again.
